chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Eight States in Which Divine Love Resides

---

**¶1:** The [GAP-1] living divine love is present in eight distinct states of reception.

**¶2:** The first state in which it resides is this [GAP-2] plane of the receptive mind [GAP-3] where it dwells and subsists. It is established at the deepest level, [GAP-4] utterly beneath and prior to every other state. It is the foundation and ground-principle of the entire natural mind, and the inmost perception that underlies all other faculties.

**¶3:** The second state in which it resides is the Divine Itself, the God of truth; because the Divine Itself is established in His great and sovereign perception. Thus, divine love exists first in the Divine. The other faculties that proceeded from Him were made manifest through Him, and divine love too came forth with them and was made manifest through them.

**¶4:** The third [GAP-5] state in which it resides is the Celestial Human — he who [GAP-6] bears protective truths as spiritual armor. Again, it is this divine love [GAP-7] dwelling upon the external form of the Complete Regenerate Person.

**¶5:** The fourth is this divine love that was separated and purified from all the [GAP-8] wisdom-bearing faculties, which resides in the outermost doctrinal boundary, in the vessel of illuminated understanding.

**¶6:** The fifth is this divine love that is within the lesser light of obscured understanding [GAP-9] — hidden within truth itself.

**¶7:** [GAP-10] The sixth is this divine love that is purified from the whole of what proceeds. The Divine [GAP-11] Proceeding clothed it upon His own external form, over the calling-forth and the willing reception. He established many things by means of it. He descended into lower states and divested Himself of it before the Guardian of the threshold between degrees.

**¶8:** The seventh is this living divine love that belongs to the regenerated natural mind, and it is the foundational perception. For it is the first ground-principle in the regenerated mind; upon it they built anew [GAP-12] the first course of interior order, which is the ruling love crowning the entire natural plane. These principles lie beneath everything else, spread over the entire plane of falsity from evil [GAP-13] contained within it, throughout the [GAP-14] whole [GAP-15] of that darkened region.

**¶9:** [GAP-16] The eighth is the divine love that shall be revealed in this [GAP-17] ultimate state of the person, and it signifies holy dread and spiritual combat. Furthermore it [GAP-18] displays and manifests its confirmation in the awe it inspires. It shall be revealed within these two vessels of doctrine — the vessel of interior wisdom and the vessel of exterior understanding.

**¶10:** This is the manner in which the holy living divine love exists throughout these [GAP-19] eight states of reception.

---

### Translator's Note

The entire chapter maps the one reality — *living divine love* — across eight degrees of manifestation, from the inmost ground of the receptive mind, through the Divine Itself, through the celestial human equipped for spiritual combat, through the vessels of illuminated and obscured understanding, through the Divine Proceeding that descends and divests itself at the boundary between discrete degrees, into the regenerated natural mind, and finally into the ultimate state where divine love appears as holy dread and the power of spiritual combat. The architecture is that of influx descending through discrete degrees and terminating in ultimates — precisely the Swedenborgian doctrine that love must pass through every plane and clothe itself in each successive form before it can act in the final natural state.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.

The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it and ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and basis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.

The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o put on his five sons as his] armour. Again, it is this fire [that was set and placed] on the body of the Perfect Man.
[The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
[The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [and is concealed] within the water.

[The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.

The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [and they established within it] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [that exists] in it, in the [great] whole [of the darkness]

[The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [last time upon every] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [is revealed, and] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].

fills.explanation: The "holy living fire" is the standard Kephalaia designation for this divine principle; "holy" corresponds to the sacred quality of divine love throughout the chapter.
"Light land" is the standard Manichaean term for the realm of luminous reception, corresponding to the receptive plane of the mind in the spiritual reading.
The editor's phrase fits the spiritual reading ("where it dwells and subsists") and matches the Kephalaia register of describing presence and existence together.

Yields "beneath it and utterly beyond the totality," matching the spiritual reading's "utterly beneath and prior to every other state" — the fire is established beneath the light land and utterly beyond all else.
This confirms the editor's choice; the formula "place wherein it is" is the recurring structural phrase used for each of the eight places (matching ¶2 and ¶3 exactly).

fills.explanation: The First Man putting on his five sons (the five light elements) as armor is the foundational Manichaean teaching, matching the spiritual reading's "bears protective truths as spiritual armor."

The spiritual reading says "dwelling upon the external form," and in Kephalaia register fire placed upon a body uses establishment language; this also echoes the armor-on-body imagery from the preceding clause.
"Light powers" is the standard Kephalaia term for the luminous emanations; the spiritual reading's "wisdom-bearing faculties" corresponds to light as the vehicle of divine wisdom.

The spiritual reading says "hidden within truth itself"; in Manichaean cosmology the fire within the moon (light-giver of the night) is concealed within water, and "concealed" is the natural-plane equivalent of "hidden."
Confirms the editor's reading; "The" is the standard article opening each enumerated place, matching the structural pattern throughout the chapter.

The "Living Spirit" is the standard Manichaean divine figure who descends and acts upon creation; the spiritual reading's "Divine Proceeding" corresponds exactly to the Living Spirit who proceeds from the divine realm.

The building metaphor requires an establishment verb following "built anew"; the spiritual reading indicates foundational laying of interior order, and "established within it" fits the Kephalaia construction register.

The spiritual reading says "contained within it"; in Kephalaia register, "that exists in it" expresses the principle of darkness being contained and present within the earth, using the chapter's characteristic existential phrasing.

The syntactic slot before "whole" requires an intensifying adjective, and "great" (ⲛⲟϭ) is the most common such modifier in the Kephalaia for cosmic descriptors, paralleling "great earth" earlier in the same chapter.

The spiritual reading says "of that darkened region"; in Kephalaia natural-plane vocabulary, "of the darkness" completes "the whole of the darkness," denoting the entire dark realm beneath the new earth.
Confirms the editor's reading; "The" follows the consistent enumeration pattern ("The sixth... The seventh... The eighth...") used throughout the chapter.

The spiritual reading says "ultimate state of the person"; in Manichaean eschatology the eighth fire is the Last Fire revealed at the end of time upon every person, and "last time" is standard Kephalaia eschatological vocabulary.

The paragraph's central theme is revelation ("shall be revealed" appears twice); this connector introduces the manifestation clause, matching the spiritual reading's structure of the fire displaying its confirmation.
Confirms the editor's reading; the closing summary mirrors the opening statement exactly — "the holy living fire exists in these eight places" — completing the chapter's ring structure.
